description: Connects your domain or subdomain to your published Kelas AI website by adding the ownership verification TXT record, IPv4 routing A record, and HTTPS certificate authorization CNAME record in one step.
variableDescription: %verify_token%: unique ownership verification token issued by Kelas AI. %cert_host%: per-project Google Certificate Manager label suffix under _acme-challenge_. %cert_target%: unique Google Certificate Manager DNS authorization target under authorize.certificatemanager.goog.
